title: Reading overlay
chooseHook: Choose a LunaHook dialogue hook from the toolbar.
clickThrough: Let clicks pass through ({{shortcut}} to interact again)
lookupFailed: Could not open the dictionary. Try again.
settingsHint: Choose Overlay in the VN library to open it automatically. Read and look up words without leaving the game.
hideWhenUnfocused: Hide overlay when switching away from the VN
hideWhenUnfocusedHint: Turn off to keep it visible while the VN is running. Show Overlay reveals it until you return to the VN.
blockCtrl: Keep Ctrl from the VN while the mouse is over the overlay
blockCtrlHint: Most VNs skip text while Ctrl is held. Shortcuts like Ctrl+Shift+I still work, and nothing changes in click-through mode.
toolbarTitleHoverOnly: Show toolbar buttons only when hovering over the title bar
textVisibility: Text when the pointer is away
idleOpacityHint: Applies when the overlay is set to dim on hover exit.
lookupDelayHint: Time to wait after hovering over a word. Set to 0 for immediate lookup.
shortcutHint: For example, Ctrl+Shift+O. Leave empty to disable.
shortcutError: Could not register {{shortcut}}. Choose another shortcut.
saveFailed: Could not save the overlay settings.

popup.title: Dictionary popup
popup.opacityHint: Independent of the overlay opacity. Use 100 for an opaque background.
popup.closeDelayHint: Time to reach the popup after leaving the text, or return after leaving the popup.

textStyle.title: Text style
textStyle.outlineHint: Set to 0 to disable the outline.
textStyle.shadowHint: Set to 0 to disable the shadow.
textStyle.sample: 日本語の文章を読みます。
